finish.description: Discovery and authentication are complete. Configure optional light and automation behavior for this installation.

data_description.enable_light_mood_select: Adds a separate select entity for scenes and moods. It does not expose the individual child lights from a LightController.

auto.title: Automatic Loxone discovery
auto.description: Enter your Loxone username and password. The integration will scan the local network for a Loxone server (Miniserver, Miniserver Go, Miniserver Compact). Intercom video uses the same account by default; only set dedicated Intercom video credentials later in Options if your device requires it.

select.title: Select Loxone server
select.description: More than one Loxone server was found. Choose the device you want to connect.

manual.title: Manual Loxone server setup
manual.description: Enter the address and port of your Loxone server. For Miniserver Gen 1, enter the configured HTTP port.
